# sonarqube_cloud_organization (Data Source)

Reads one SonarQube Cloud organization. Organizations exist in SonarQube Cloud only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the organization to read.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) Address of the avatar of the organization.
- `description` (String) Description of the organization.
- `name` (String) Name of the organization.
- `url` (String) Address of the web page of the organization.
